req.title: Empty player list returns empty array
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players when the table is empty with HTTP 200 and an empty JSON array.
triggers: empty player list returns empty array

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-025 requires GET /players/ to return HTTP 200 and an empty JSON array when the player table is empty. The shipped fixture has 26 rows, so the positive test must mock/override the DB session to return an empty list. We test: (1) positive EP — empty DB yields 200 + []; (2) negative NEG — a non-empty DB yields 200 but a non-empty array (proving the empty-array assertion is meaningful and not trivially true); (3) boundary BVA — exactly zero items vs exactly one item in the response list, catching off-by-one mutations on the list length check; (4) DT — verifying the response Content-Type and exact body structure to kill constant/type mutations. We use FastAPI TestClient with dependency_overrides to inject a mock AsyncSession that returns a controlled list, keeping tests deterministic and independent of the real SQLite file.

import asyncio
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app
from databases.player_database import generate_async_session
from routes.player_route import simple_memory_cache, CACHE_KEY

async def _clear_cache():
    await simple_memory_cache.delete(CACHE_KEY)

asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(_clear_cache())

def _empty_session():
    mock_result = MagicMock()
    mock_result.scalars.return_value.all.return_value = []
    mock_session = AsyncMock()
    mock_session.execute = AsyncMock(return_value=mock_result)
    mock_session.get = AsyncMock(return_value=None)
    return mock_session

async def _override():
    yield _empty_session()

app.dependency_overrides[generate_async_session] = _override

def test_get_players_empty_table_returns_200_and_empty_array():
    asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(_clear_cache())
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body == []
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 0

test_get_players_empty_table_returns_200_and_empty_array()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()

import asyncio
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock
from uuid import UUID
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app
from databases.player_database import generate_async_session
from routes.player_route import simple_memory_cache, CACHE_KEY
from schemas.player_schema import Player

async def _clear_cache():
    await simple_memory_cache.delete(CACHE_KEY)

asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(_clear_cache())

def _one_player_session():
    p = Player()
    p.id = UUID('acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c')
    p.first_name = 'Lionel'
    p.middle_name = 'Andrés'
    p.last_name = 'Messi'
    p.date_of_birth = '1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z'
    p.squad_number = 10
    p.position = 'Right Winger'
    p.abbr_position = 'RW'
    p.team = 'Paris Saint-Germain'
    p.league = 'Ligue 1'
    p.starting11 = True
    mock_result = MagicMock()
    mock_result.scalars.return_value.all.return_value = [p]
    mock_session = AsyncMock()
    mock_session.execute = AsyncMock(return_value=mock_result)
    return mock_session

async def _override():
    yield _one_player_session()

app.dependency_overrides[generate_async_session] = _override

def test_get_players_nonempty_table_returns_200_and_nonempty_array():
    asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(_clear_cache())
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 1
    assert body[0]['squadNumber'] == 10

import asyncio
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock
from uuid import UUID
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app
from databases.player_database import generate_async_session
from routes.player_route import simple_memory_cache, CACHE_KEY
from schemas.player_schema import Player

async def _clear():
    await simple_memory_cache.delete(CACHE_KEY)

def _make_session(players_list):
    mock_result = MagicMock()
    mock_result.scalars.return_value.all.return_value = players_list
    mock_session = AsyncMock()
    mock_session.execute = AsyncMock(return_value=mock_result)
    return mock_session

def _make_player():
    p = Player()
    p.id = UUID('acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c')
    p.first_name = 'Lionel'
    p.middle_name = 'Andrés'
    p.last_name = 'Messi'
    p.date_of_birth = '1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z'
    p.squad_number = 10
    p.position = 'Right Winger'
    p.abbr_position = 'RW'
    p.team = 'Paris Saint-Germain'
    p.league = 'Ligue 1'
    p.starting11 = True
    return p

def test_get_players_boundary_zero_vs_one_item():
    asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(_clear())
    async def _empty_override():
        yield _make_session([])
    app.dependency_overrides[generate_async_session] = _empty_override
    client = TestClient(app)
    r0 = client.get('/players/')
    assert r0.status_code == 200
    body0 = r0.json()
    assert body0 == []
    assert len(body0) == 0
    asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(_clear())
    async def _one_override():
        yield _make_session([_make_player()])
    app.dependency_overrides[generate_async_session] = _one_override
    r1 = client.get('/players/')
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    body1 = r1.json()
    assert len(body1) == 1
    assert body1[0]['squadNumber'] == 10
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()

test_get_players_boundary_zero_vs_one_item()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()

import asyncio
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app
from databases.player_database import generate_async_session
from routes.player_route import simple_memory_cache, CACHE_KEY

async def _clear():
    await simple_memory_cache.delete(CACHE_KEY)

asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(_clear())

def _empty_session():
    mock_result = MagicMock()
    mock_result.scalars.return_value.all.return_value = []
    mock_session = AsyncMock()
    mock_session.execute = AsyncMock(return_value=mock_result)
    return mock_session

async def _override():
    yield _empty_session()

app.dependency_overrides[generate_async_session] = _override

def test_get_players_empty_response_content_type_and_exact_body():
    asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(_clear())
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r.headers['content-type']
    assert r.text == '[]'
    assert r.json() == []
    assert len(r.json()) == 0
